meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要从 RNA 测序数据中找出基因之间的调控关系
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target regulatory links from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find regulatory relationships in RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能从基因表达数据推断基因调控网络,用 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 算法,产出含转录因子、靶基因和重要性分数的结果表格。
howto.when: 当你要求分析转录组数据(如 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq),找转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时,会启用该技能。

say.text: 只保留 importance 大于 0.5 的调控关系
say.note: 过滤出重要性更高的链接

say.text: 把这批单细胞数据设 seed 777 再跑一次

howto.what_en: Claude can infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data using GRNBoost2 or GENIE3, outputting a table of transcription factors, target genes and importance scores.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to analyze transcriptomics data such as bulk RNA-seq or single-cell RNA-seq and identify transcription factor-target regulatory relationships.

say_en.text: Infer a regulatory network from expression_data.tsv with GRNBoost2.
Keep only regulatory links with importance above 0.5.
Re-run this single-cell dataset with seed 777.
